notes: «بهذا الإسناد» closes the main route as a back_reference; it is not inherited because the names before it are written in this report

Tirmidhi's remark «سمعت إسحاق بن منصور، يقول روى أحمد بن حنبل، وعلي بن المديني، وإسحاق بن إبراهيم» names other transmitters of the same hadith from Abd al-Razzaq: a variant group; Ishaq ibn Mansur, the speaker of the remark, is not a link
«ومن سمع من عبد الرزاق ...» is a judgment on who names Yunus b. Yazid, with no chain: left out
